capabilities: Sync Excalidraw drawings to ExcaliDash instances using frontmatter opt-in metadata
Configure sync per drawing or per folder via the Excalidash Sync command
Run one-way (default) or bidirectional sync with conflict detection
Authenticate with username/password or API keys against ExcaliDash's /api routes
extras: ExcaliDash does not yet support API keys; the author offers forked Docker images until an upstream PR merges. Bidirectional pulls into compressed-json Excalidraw notes are unsupported. Sync is currently manual only; automatic syncing (on save, periodic) is a future plan.
problem: Excalidraw drawings stored in the vault have no built-in way to be synced or published to an ExcaliDash instance.

relations.evidence: Sync the current Obsidian Excalidraw note to ExcaliDash by using frontmatter opt-in metadata.
use Obsidian-to-ExcaliDash sync for those files

summary: Syncs Obsidian Excalidraw notes to ExcaliDash instances via frontmatter metadata, with one-way or bidirectional sync and collection support.
